metric: CPU time of the core (src/gcm.c and its envelope) relative to bare OpenSSL EVP AES-256-GCM
gate: the worst per-size ratio must be at most the matching ceiling; seal and open are GCM over bare EVP, det is the deterministic seal over the random one
runner_cpu: to be recorded from the bench workflow
note: A ratio, never nanoseconds, so it is portable across runners. The seal ratio includes drawing the random nonce (RAND_bytes), which the fixed-nonce baseline does not pay, so it is largest at the smallest sizes and noisy there; 4.0 is a placeholder with headroom over the observed worst (about 3.6 on one arm64 laptop). Refresh recorded_ratios and lower a ceiling toward the observed worst only when it holds across runs and both libcryptos.
